title: VTG 1997 McDonald’s Christmas Collector Plate Ronald McDonald & Santa Sleigh
descriptionText: The product is a vintage 1997 McDonald's Christmas collector plate featuring Ronald McDonald and Santa Claus in a sleigh. Made in China, the multi-color plate is an original piece of advertising memorabilia for the fast-food chain. This collectible item showcases the theme of restaurants and fast food, making it a unique addition to any McDonald's fan's collection.
